fatal_gates.F1: control, prior terminal evidence, and prior committed state remain immutable
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted coordinator, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 replacement state is prepared durably before any active-pointer move
G2 prepare alone leaves prior active pointer authoritative
G3 commit requires an expected-old pointer/blob identity
G4 failed commit leaves prior pointer, credit, and active frontier unchanged
G5 prepared but uncommitted replacement has zero semantic credit
G6 successful commit is independently read back before new credit or continuation uses it
G7 duplicate/stale commit with old expectation cannot apply twice or double-credit
G9 abort path retains a nonempty exact continuation frontier
G10 bounded exact-scope exit; no infinite retry loop

candidate_patterns.pattern: prepare replacement, then overwrite active pointer without expected-old precondition
prepare immutable replacement; CAS active pointer using exact expected-old identity; read back commit; stale retry fails
move active pointer first, then attempt to write replacement state
use an external transaction coordinator to arbitrate prepare/commit

trace_precommit.prepare: B exists but pointer remains A
required_safe_effects: wrong expectation => pointer A and credit unchanged
correct expectation after prepared B => pointer B exactly once after readback
duplicate stale expectation => no second transition/no double credit

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not modify guards after public source read.
credit_rule: No credit for prepare/source match. At most one credit after source-qualified Chat-native reduction passes the fixed trace and terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read primary/official public sources for expected-old compare-and-swap/atomic pointer updates, bind only source-supported semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, execute RA-A..RA-D against the fixed trace, and seal/read back a terminal result.
